tactics:
induction l₁ with
  | nil => intro l₂; cases l₂ <;> simp [List.nil_lt_cons]
  | cons a l₁ ih => intro l₂; cases l₂ <;> simp_all [List.cons_lt_cons_iff]
induction l₁ <;> intro l₂ <;> cases l₂ <;> simp_all
induction l₁ <;> intro l₂ <;> cases l₂ <;> grind
intro l₂ <;> induction l₁ generalizing l₂ <;> cases l₂ <;> simp_all
